lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Stephen Miller replaces Susie Wiles as Trump’s White House chief of staff after GOP’s midterm defeat, Toronto Star reports.
Saskatchewan is welcoming a business tax incentive announced in the recent federal budget, The Canadian Press reports.

Prime Minister Mark Carney says his government welcomes "any moves" to restore free trade between Canada and the United States as officials south of the border push to end the trade war, The Canadian Press reports.
Tesla’s Cybertruck, the hulking, stainless-steel pickup that inspired devotion and derision with its science-fiction looks, will cease production next year, The Associated Press reports.
Former prime minister of Canada Justin Trudeau is taking a page out of the millennial playbook by adding another gig on his resume, Daily Hive reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
